本晨播聚焦于NCAA锦标赛、MLB世界棒球经典赛以及NFL明星球员的商业策略。

  • David Levy：NCAA锦标赛背后的推手

    David Levy在Turner Broadcasting工作了33年，并且是该网络NBA赛事扩张的关键人物。他与Alex和Jason讨论了March Madness的细节，包括如何让每场NCAA锦标赛都能通过CBS和Turner网络进行全国直播。

    Levy的故事展示了体育转播权谈判的重要性以及如何利用媒体资源来增加观众基础。

  • MLB世界棒球经典赛：美国与委内瑞拉的决赛

    今年的世界棒球经典赛吸引了10亿以上的日本球迷观看，而美国和委内瑞拉之间的决赛更是引起了极大的关注。

    这场比赛展示了体育赛事如何通过媒体平台吸引全球观众，并对未来的赛季产生影响。

  • NFL明星球员Bobby Wagner的商业策略

    Bobby Wagner作为NFC历史上唯一一位达到2000次擒抱的线卫，他正在效仿Michael Jordan和Magic Johnson的职业生涯模式。Wagner分享了他的投资经验和如何处理自己的合同。

    通过讨论他的商业策略，Wagner展示了运动员如何利用他们的影响力来影响体育产业的发展方向。

  • David Levy is the Reason You’re Watching March Madness

    It&rsquo;s brackets season! And you can watch all 67 games of both the women&rsquo;s and men&rsquo;s NCAA tournament on national TV, thanks to David Levy. Levy spent 33 years at Turner Broadcasting, eventually serving as its president, where he expanded the network&rsquo;s NBA coverage. Levy is probably best known for brokering a $10.8 billion rights agreement that made every March Madness game available nationally across CBS and the Turner networks for the very first time. In this episode of The Deal, Alex and Jason talk to Levy about the ins and outs of the March Madness deal. He also tells the story of how he got Shaq to fill Inside the NBA&rsquo;s fourth chair and why the key to that show&rsquo;s success is letting Charles Barkley talk. Finally, Levy shares more about his current venture, Horizon Sports & Experiences, and why he&rsquo;s betting big on women&rsquo;s sports and pickleball.
